snippet.title: Drakantos | Closed Beta Teaser
snippet.description:
The beta will run this week from July 25 to 27, starting at 9 AM ET on Friday. Request access here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454980?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=comingup&utm_medium=closedbeta

Check the Closed Beta information here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2454980/view/529852577067565223

Drakantos is a free-to-play MMORPG with more than 20 playable heroes, competitive PvP modes, and hundreds of PvE missions!
